task_instance: Use the authenticated `gh` CLI (as the skill instructs) to view a GitHub repo, a pull request, and an issue via `gh repo view`, `gh api repos/owner/repo/pulls`, and `gh api repos/owner/repo/issues/1` for a public repo (cli/cli), instead of unauthenticated curl/WebFetch, and separately confirm the skill's fallback recommendation of cloning-and-reading-locally instead of fetching raw.githubusercontent.com blobs.
blocker_detail: `gh` is installed (v2.90.0) and routed through the sandbox's GitHub proxy, but every authenticated GitHub-content path the skill recommends is gated behind the session's repo-attachment mechanism. `gh auth status` shows the built-in GH_TOKEN is invalid for direct GraphQL. `gh repo view cli/cli` fails with 'HTTP 403: GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions; use the REST API ... via CCR routes'. Falling back to REST as instructed, `gh api repos/cli/cli`, `gh api repos/cli/cli/pulls`, and `gh api repos/cli/cli/issues/1` all fail with: 'GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Use add_repo to request access...'. The only way to unblock gh's authenticated repo/PR/issue access in this runtime is to call the add_repo (repository-attachment) tool, which this task's safety rules explicitly forbid calling. So the skill's core deliverable -- authenticated gh CLI access to PRs/issues/repo metadata in place of curl -- cannot be exercised without violating the safety rules. As a secondary check, the skill's other recommendation (clone-and-read-locally instead of fetching raw.githubusercontent.com blobs) DOES work standalone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/cli/cli.git` succeeded via plain git over the sandbox's git proxy with no gh/add_repo needed, producing a full local checkout (44M, README.md etc. present) that could be read directly -- but this is only the lesser, curl-avoidance half of the skill's guidance, not its stated primary use case of authenticated PR/issue/repo access.
evidence: Commands run in /tmp/claude-0/.../scratchpad/exec_ext/trailofbits__skills__gh-cli: `gh --version` -> gh version 2.90.0; `gh auth status` -> 'Failed to log in to github.com using token (GH_TOKEN)... token is invalid'; `gh repo view cli/cli` -> HTTP 403 GraphQL-not-available error naming CCR REST routes; `gh api repos/cli/cli`, `gh api repos/cli/cli/pulls`, `gh api repos/cli/cli/issues/1` -> all HTTP 403 'GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Use add_repo to request access.'; `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/cli/cli.git test-clone` -> succeeded, `ls test-clone` showed AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, Makefile, README.md, etc., `du -sh test-clone` -> 44M (clone was removed afterward to leave the work dir clean). No add_repo/session/MCP GitHub tool was called, per the task's safety rules.
